meta.caveat: Coverage varies by country. Many series start around 1960. Each index is a national consumer price measure and baskets differ between countries, so cross-country comparisons are approximate. High-inflation countries may have redenominated their currency; the index ratio accounts for this because prices and currency were redenominated together.
